title: The Theory of Plafales: P vs NP Problem Solution
content: In this paper, we consider the properties of the following objects: plafal and geo-space (a general overview). As an application of the created theory, the proof of the equality of complexity classes P and NP will be given. The geo-plafal is a kernel (computational template) of the proof; constructive theory of serendipity approximations, Stepanets' school and the Bogolyubov principle of the decay of correlations for an infinite systems (dim=3) is a shell.
